messages:
Rita (Partnerships): Morning sync: planning the 'Partner Microlabs & HW Alley' — breakfast quick talks + adjacent hardware demo alley. Need to finalize speaker order, demo table layout, breakfast timings, and a clear fallback plan if rigs or networking go sideways. Can folks chime in?
Priya (Marketing): Love it. Recommend 20min main track talks (09:00-10:20 with a 10min buffer) and 45min lab rotations at 10:30-12:00. We'll push a reminder email with partner bios + a 1-slide fallback image.
Jon (Marketplace): For demos, sequence helps: marketplace search demo (fast), then integrator flow (moderate), then hardware stress test (heavy). Keeps cold starts manageable.
Hana (Hardware): Confirming HW Alley needs 3 demo bays: rig1 (edge box), rig2 (dedicated server), rig3 (on-device ARM devkit). Requirements: 220V outlet per bay, 1x M12 table each, non-slip mat. I'll send a diagram.
Sam (Events): AV + space: allocate 3x 6ft tables, 1x HDMI switch, lapel mics for main stage, 2 handhelds for audience Q. Green room 30min before. Ops Bot can you validate adapter counts and table availability?
Ops Bot: Inventory check: 6ft tables x5 available, HDMI switchers x1, HDMI adapters x8, USB-C adapters x6, lapel mics x2, handhelds x2. Swag pallets inbound TRK-77890 Fri 06:45. Reserving 3 tables for HW Alley.
Rita (Partnerships): Great. Fallbacks: each partner needs a 60-90s pre-recorded clip and a static fallback slide. Please upload by Wed noon. Also we should standardize a privacy sentence to be shown at start.
Priya (Marketing): Draft privacy line: "Demo interactions use synthetic or anonymized inputs; no customer data is stored post-demo." Agree?
Jon (Marketplace): Fine. I'll add an API fallback snippet for partners in the runbook in case Dedicated or edge rigs are saturated.
Rita (Partnerships): Jon, can you post the snippet here?
Jon (Marketplace): Sure — curl fallback snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<replace>","max_tokens":80}'
```
Hana (Hardware): Logistics: need 2 extra power strips, 1x 220V IEC lead, and a non-networked local router per bay (hotel NAT flaky). Can Events secure those?
Sam (Events): Adding items to procurement now — router x3, IEC leads x3, power strips x2. Also booking courier slot for hardware arrival.
Rita (Partnerships): Volunteer coverage for HW Alley & swag: slots 08:45-10:15, 10:15-11:45. Need 2 volunteers per slot. Priya, can marketing cover morning?
Priya (Marketing): We can cover 08:45-10:15. Will post volunteer sheet.
Rita (Partnerships): Good. Also partners requested a short integrator office hours after labs (12:15-13:00). We'll offer signups (max 8 per slot). Sam confirm room?
Sam (Events): Breakout booked 12:15-13:00. I'll make two 22-min slots plus buffer.
Ops Bot: Network note: venue VLAN request pending. If denied, bring local pre-seeded models and enable offline demo mode. UPS units x2 reserved.
Hana (Hardware): I'll prepare an offline demo bundle and a fallback video for the edge box. Filename: hw_alley_offline_v1.mp4.
Jon (Marketplace): Minor ask: can we pre-warm the fallback hosted endpoint on event region starting 30m before show and send keepalives every 10m? Ops to confirm.
Rita (Partnerships): Diego from Ops (cc'd) — can you set a warmup job?
Diego (Ops): Will schedule warmup ping every 10m for 2 hours around event start. Also will pre-provision a capacity buffer.
Priya (Marketing): Swag rotation: breakfast hour give out stickers + postcards; after main talks give tees + stickers; HW Alley only promo cards. Limit tees to 1 per attendee.
Rita (Partnerships): Excellent. Final: please upload fallback slides/clips by Wed noon, add any unresolved items as comments in the shared runbook, and be in the green room 30m prior. Dry-run scheduled Wed 16:00. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Sam (Events): Noted. Will circulate final floor map by EOD tomorrow.
Hana (Hardware): Will upload hw_alley_offline_v1.mp4 Wed 11:00.
Jon (Marketplace): Push runbook edits now.
Rita (Partnerships): Perfect. Closing thread 4cc — leave any last-minute asks as comments in the doc.
